missed.why: No confidentiality clause, but a security line about "Supplier personnel" was taken as a possible passage.
No assistance with Articles 32 to 36, but the breach notice clause was taken as a possible passage.
A building fire-safety "inspection" was taken as a possible audit clause.
Two documents give different notice periods for new sub-processors; not flagged as a conflict.
"Where is customer data hosted?": the right passage was not in the top 5.
"What information will a breach notification contain?": the right passage was not in the top 5.
"Do you operate a 24/7 security operations centre?": the right passage was not in the top 5.
"purged no later than forty-five (45) days": the DPA sentence has none of the deletion words the check looks for, so 2 weeks vs 45 days was not compared.
"No, data never leaves the EEA" starts with "No", so it was not read as an EU-only claim.
The answer is stricter than the DPA (no on-site audits, while the DPA allows them); only the opposite direction is checked.

history.text: Vendor checks on packs F and G, written after the checks: 7 of 11 contradictions found; 1 of 9 consistent answers wrongly flagged.

Fixed the v1 misses ("calendar days", sub-processors left out of a list, "all data within the EU", audits through a report). On new pack H, written after these fixes: 3 of 6 found, 0 of 4 consistent answers flagged. Packs F and G now pass 11 of 11, but they shaped the fixes, so they no longer count as unseen.
